TGO.note: The document states no rule or authority on AI harms; an ethical-use pillar of a strategy in preparation is not a rule.
The document states no government use of an AI system.
The document states no AI law or draft text.
The document states no AI tool in a public sector system.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation held a feedback workshop on 19 December 2025 on the work to draw up Togo's National AI Strategy, which rests on six pillars.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Efficacité du Service Public et de la Transformation Numérique

TGO.note: Dataset production is only a pillar of a strategy in preparation, not a dataset built.
The document states no government data exchange platform.

facts.fact: The ministry says its 19 December 2025 workshop on the draft National AI Strategy brought together actors from various ministries, the private sector and civil society, and gathered participants' remarks and contributions.
